tools.name: get_spain_registrations_summary
tools.description: Get an official Spain DGT passenger-car (M1) registrations executive summary for a given month (YYYY-MM) or year (YYYY), optionally filtered by Spanish Autonomous Community (CCAA). Returns total registrations, fuel/powertrain mix (BEV, PHEV, HEV, Petrol, Diesel, Gas), Top 5 brands, Top 5 models, Top

tools.name: get_spain_ccaa_electrification_ranking
tools.description: Rank all 17 Spanish Autonomous Communities (plus Ceuta & Melilla) by 100% electric (BEV) and Zero-Emission (BEV+PHEV) market share, showing each region's current #1 propulsion technology and percentage-point gap for BEV to become the #1 technology.

tools.name: get_spain_latest_dgt_plate
tools.description: Get the latest official Spanish vehicle license plate series and number issued by the DGT (e.g. '7160 NVJ'), date of issue, next upcoming 3-letter series, and recent series timeline.

tools.name: get_europe_ev_comparison
tools.description: Compare passenger-car registrations and electric vehicle (BEV & PHEV) market share across Spain (DGT), Germany (KBA), France (PFA), and the United Kingdom (SMMT) for a given year.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_spain_latest_dgt_plate · Public sink: get_spain_ccaa_electrification_ranking, get_spain_brand_summary, get_europe_ev_comparison.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_spain_latest_dgt_plate · Public sink: get_spain_ccaa_electrification_ranking, get_spain_brand_summary, get_europe_ev_comparison

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
